title: Poland Political Crisis Tracker Update — Oct 17, 2026
summary: Warsaw prosecutors charged the 66-year-old suspect, Krzysztof N., with nine offences on 13 Oct, the gravest being plotting to forcibly overthrow state authorities with stockpiled explosives. Improvised explosive materials were reportedly found in his home, and prosecutors say he recruited a group of several hundred. He denies the offences; a custody ruling was due 14 Oct but its outcome was not found. No foreign link reported.

title: Poland Political Crisis Tracker Update — Oct 15, 2026
summary: No new verified developments since the 11 Oct detention of a man in his 60s in Lower Silesia over threats against PM Tusk and Defence Minister Kosiniak-Kamysz. As of 13 Oct reporting, searches of his home were continuing and investigators were examining his contacts and online activity. No charges, court proceedings or foreign link had been reported. Existing data was left unchanged.

title: Poland Political Crisis Tracker Update — Tue Oct 13, 2026
summary: Warsaw regional prosecutors announced on 13 Oct that the suspect, identified as Krzysztof N., 66, faces nine charges.

title: Poland Political Crisis Tracker Update — Sun Oct 11, 2026
